name: Shadcn Play
summary: Browser playground for shadcn/ui components: write JSX with Tailwind classes, see instant previews and share creations.
description: An interactive playground for shadcn/ui components where you write JSX with Tailwind CSS classes, get an instant preview and share your creations. Built as a Next.js app with the Monaco Editor and Tailwind CSS; the repository has been renamed to ephraimduncan/shadcn-playground and the deployed playground runs at play.blocks.so with a command palette for quick actions.
contains: live JSX editor with instant component preview
share your creations from the playground
built with Next.js, Monaco Editor and Tailwind CSS
